div.div:
Blue box: outside participant. Green box: process. Grey open-ended box: stored data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Subtitle tracks per language are produced after indexing and served with the Reel (44a). Series ordering,
permissions and around-Reel episode windows remain in sequences 35–36. Publication/index completion belongs to process 4.0. Store updates apply to write requests; query requests build a
permitted window without those writes.
